status: frozen after V19X4 posterior/common-grid implementation but before any V19X3 regional measurement, V19X4 observed gas posterior, invariant score, lensing or halo target, action selection, or gravity fit
purpose: Restrict the V19BJ invariant library to source quantities actually identifiable with the registered gas and member data, and freeze a filter-invariant density nuisance control before source outcomes exist.

observability_matrix.rule: Use gas and normalized stellar-light controls as separate predictors; never sum their uncalibrated amplitudes or compare I-band and F814W luminosity amplitudes across clusters.

missing_inputs: absolute stellar mass map in the same units as gas
observability_matrix.reason: The fraction f_g cannot be identified from two different single-band relative-luminosity scales without inventing a mass-to-light calibration.

missing_inputs: identified gas velocity vector or validated shock-front normal
observability_matrix.reason: A line-of-sight stellar current and scalar sound speed do not identify a projected gas-minus-stellar velocity vector.

missing_inputs: gas bulk and turbulent velocity stress
observability_matrix.reason: One line-of-sight moment plus isotropic thermal pressure cannot determine a 2D or 3D symmetric trace-free stress tensor.

observability_matrix.role: The projected 2D symmetric trace-free tensor can test amplitude and axial direction; a pass authorizes a covariant derivation but does not prove its 3D completion.
The normalized squared projected cross-gradient is an eligible scalar activation only; the 2D cross product points along the line of sight and supplies no fitted in-plane orientation.

missing_inputs: time-resolved or independently clocked material derivative
observability_matrix.reason: A single projected thermodynamic snapshot does not measure a material time derivative.

density_novelty_control.unit_of_scoring: one V19M adaptive gas region, not one common-grid pixel
density_novelty_control.stellar_amplitude: within each cluster and posterior draw, normalize nonnegative member luminosity to unit total before common-grid smoothing
predictors_at_matching_resolution: quadratic terms and pairwise interactions of those five predictors
density_novelty_control.estimator: ordinary least squares with the fixed quadratic basis
density_novelty_control.cross_validation: analytic leave-one-region-out PRESS residuals within each cluster and posterior draw
density_novelty_control.response: candidate scalar amplitude or each independent projected tensor component
density_novelty_control.reason: A thermodynamic-gradient feature must add information beyond local density, stellar morphology, and density derivatives; merely differentiating density cannot pass as novel physics.

future_scoring_order: require terminal V19X4 observed gas posterior and exact hashes
construct normalized stellar-light controls from the authoritative 4096 matched member-ensemble draws
score I4 and I5 at both 50 and 100 kpc without choosing a preferred resolution
apply the unchanged V19BJ detection, orientation, resolution, projection, leave-one-region-out and density-novelty gates
advance only if at least one scalar activation and I4 directional tensor pass both clusters
derive a covariant action before opening any lensing target

front_measurement_decision.automatic_front_route_status: paused_after_three implementation attempts failed before a valid science front catalog
front_measurement_decision.v19j: formal science pass invalidated by mandatory visual audit because smooth gradients formed contour forests
front_measurement_decision.v19l: mandatory pre-science curved-step connectivity failure; cluster science was not read
front_measurement_decision.effect: I2 is unavailable; do not tune a fourth front detector during I4/I5 scoring
front_measurement_decision.future_reconsideration: Use independently released X-ray-only front regions or a new cluster sample under a separate preregistration if I4/I5 do not identify a source.

claim_boundary: V19BK is a source-data identifiability audit, not a gravitational test.
A future I4 or I5 pass would identify an informative projected baryonic state, not demonstrate that lensing follows it.
Relative single-band member light is a morphology nuisance, not an absolute stellar-mass map.
The present data do not identify a relative-current vector, full anisotropic stress, causal time derivative or 3D source orientation.
No formula, action, operator, wavelength, coupling or universal constant is selected.
